verdict.rationale: Pomelo is a card-issuing and processing SaaS platform, so letting customers choose a data storage region is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack documents region selection or data-residency controls. The Stage and production domains are test-versus-live environments, not storage regions, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
